notes.title: Important Update on Just Survival - The Zombie Awakening
notes.content:
Important Update on Just Survival - The Zombie Awakening

Dear Just Survival Community,

First and foremost, we want to express our deepest gratitude for your patience, understanding, and unwavering support during what has been an incredibly challenging period for our team and, indeed, the world at large.

As many of you are aware, the unforeseen global events, particularly the outbreak of war in regions where our team members are located, have significantly impacted our development timeline for Just Survival - The Zombie Awakening. Our team, spread across Canada, the USA, and Israel, has faced numerous hardships due to the chaotic events unfolding around them, directly affecting our progress on the game.

The safety and well-being of our team members are our top priorities. With the situation escalating, we've taken steps to ensure their safety, which included halting development to focus on their well-being and relocation. We are relieved to share that, after several difficult months, our team is now in the process of relocating to safer locations where we can continue our work on Just Survival - The Zombie Awakening with renewed focus and determination.

We understand that delays can be disappointing, and we share in your frustration. However, we want to assure you that we are more committed than ever to delivering the game we all eagerly await. Our passion for Just Survival has only grown stronger through these trials, and we're excited to get back on track.

We have some significant news to share regarding Just Survival: The Zombie Awakening. After much consideration and feedback from our dedicated community, we’ve made the decision to rebuild the game to a completely new project!!

Our New team at Awakening Games Entertainment has been hard at work on an entirely new game build. This rebuild is our way of delivering on the vision we have always promised—a game that pushes the boundaries of survival and keeps you on the edge of your seat at every turn.

We understand that changes like this can be challenging, and we deeply appreciate your continued support and patience as we navigate this journey together. Our goal has always been to create a game that not only meets but exceeds your expectations, and we believe this rollback and the upcoming rebuild are crucial steps in that direction.

We're incredibly thankful for the community that has built up around Just Survival - The Zombie Awakening. Your support, understanding, and enthusiasm have been a beacon of light for us during these dark times. As we move forward, we're excited to bring you along on our journey, sharing every success and overcoming challenges together.

Thank you for sticking with us. Let's embark on this renewed journey together, towards the dawn of Just Survival.

With heartfelt thanks,

The Awakening Games Entertainment Development Team

notes.title: Patch Update 1.2.2
notes.content:
Thanks for your patience and support on the project, we have more frequent updates coming.

Changes made in Patch Update 1.2.2
-Fixed Lan mode, is now working correctly to play with friends.
-Improved Zombie AI Physics.
-Reduced damage required to kill zombies.
-Reduced Zombies by 50% from map.
-Fixed Save Game for single player mode (F5)
-Added more detail inside map.
-Increased detail for zombies.
-Removed damage indicator when dealing damage to enemies.
-Increased Length of daytime.
-Improved Game Optimization


Next update will include Open world servers & more exciting updates! 
Thank you from everyone at the AGE team! 
Cheers

notes.title: Major Upcoming October Update
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

We would like to thank you for your continued patience & support during our early access phase of Just Survival.
It has been very challenging to deliver the game we have promised so quickly but we can assure you that we will with a little more time.
Our major update is coming in October, here is what you can look forward 2.

-Servers Online & working properly.
-Voice & Text communication between you and your friends in the open world.
-Map expansion & Improved vehicles to drive.
-Bug fixes and glitches reduced.
-Improved graphics & game play features.
-Many more additional improvements, please wait for the upcoming announcement!

Thank you to all the players who have invested into our game & stayed with us even in it's current condition! it's you guys who help us create our masterpiece into reality using Unreal Engine 5!

Regards,
Awakening Games Entertainment
